choice.basis: The dashboard chart displays two series: 'Married couple' (blue solid line, circular markers) and 'Single women' (red dashed line, square markers). At the 2020 tick on the x-axis, the red 'Single women' marker is positioned near the top of the plot area, while the blue 'Married couple' marker is near the bottom. Assuming a standard vertical scale where higher position indicates a larger value, the 2020 count for Single women is larger than for Married couple. The task requires opening the follow-up record for the group with the larger 2020 count.
choice.option_label: Open 2020 Single women demographic follow-up record
